packageRules.description: Actions and build tools move often and matter little on their own; one pull request a week beats five.
cmake stays on 3.x. OrcaSlicer's bundled deps_src still declare cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.5), which 4.x accepts only grudgingly and will drop.

The engine pin is not an ordinary dependency: every patch in patches/ is written against this commit, and a bump means rebasing the stack and regenerating testdata/reference.gcode, which is the oracle the gates compare against. The pull request is a prompt to do that work, not something to merge.
prBodyNotes: This will fail CI until `patches/*.patch` are rebased with `scripts/regen-patch.sh` and `testdata/reference.gcode` is regenerated from the matching desktop build. See `patches/README.md`.

customManagers.description: The pinned OrcaSlicer checkout, kept as a tag and its commit so the fetch can verify what it got.
